# Ramonyx

> Full-stack TypeScript framework (Node.js ≥ 24) with file routing, SSR React + hydration, soft
> navigation, secure defaults, server actions, edge/static targets, and an experimental Rust/V8 runtime.

Documentation: https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/ . Structured facts: https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/ .

## Search

This site has a search endpoint: https://context7.com/api/v2/ask?siteKey=ask_89339fd8bad939f239a589fa&query=<URL-encoded question>. It returns documentation that answers the question, with a source link for each part. No API key is needed. If nothing matches, it says so.

## Machine-readable (public only)

- [features.json](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/features.json): feature status (implemented/partial/experimental/planned), packages, evidence, limitations
- [adrs.json](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/adrs.json): 9 public architecture decisions (one-line decision + relations)
- [rules.json](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/rules.json): rules for writing apps, with good/bad examples
- [glossary.json](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/glossary.json): terms and concept map
- [stats.json](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/stats.json): version, packages, public ADR count, test counts
- [api.json](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/api.json) and [cli.json](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/cli.json): extracted API/CLI reference
- [recipes.json](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/recipes.json): task recipes (page/loader, actions, APIs, auth, cache, testing, deploy)
- [config.schema.json](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/config.schema.json): ramonyx.config.ts shape (verified by tests)

## For agents

- [llms-full.txt](https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/machine/llms-full.txt): public machine layer + all public docs in one file
- Markdown per page: append `.md` to a docs URL (e.g. https://ramonyx.devmoon.net/docs/getting-started.md)
- MCP server: `npx -y @ramonyx/mcp-docs-server` (stdio; public docs snapshot)
- [Context7](https://context7.com/websites/ramonyx_devmoon_net): searchable docs index + Ask endpoint
